title: 'The Wood Question' and similar hold-level disputes read as settled once one stakeholder is convinced, but the losing stakeholders' dialogue keeps offering to re-litigate indefinitely with real reputation stakes, so a 'Quest done' tag doesn't reliably mean the topic stops costing you standing.
